description: A session.start hook registers /gateway and starts a two-second check: a lead watches the bridge pointer until Remote Control registers this process, then sets Model Gateway's env block on the running process and writes its mode for its teammates; a tmux teammate follows its lead's mode, wiring before its first model request; either leaves the gateway after two unreachable health checks and returns after two reachable ones. A classic.SessionStart hook turns a lead on at start when the settings hook `/gateway setup` writes answers `/gateway on`.
